claim: In In re Citigroup the Delaware Court of Chancery refused to extend the Caremark oversight duty, which concerns monitoring for illegal conduct, into oversight liability for business risk, so an inability to predict the future and an incorrect evaluation of business risk are not breaches of a director's oversight responsibilities.
